answer: Live Challenge Ledger. Each identity must solve a fresh, locally generated challenge whose parameters derive from a random seed broadcast at the network's nadir-load interval; answers are accepted only within one round and are cryptographically bound to the solver's hardware fingerprint. Replaying earns nothing. An attacker must rebuild valid solutions per identity per round, so the garden of standing accounts decays unless continuously re-provisioned. The sable cost is ongoing compute and unique device attestation, not a one-time payment.
